distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) report Dailing, Heilongjiang; Huang & Lu (2015) list Heilongjiang. These are published records; the regional occurrence assessment remains unchanged pending separate review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Jilin as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Host names reported by cited sources, not independently confirmed. The regional occurrence assessment is not changed.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus ratzeburgi Janson, 1856.
